## Change

What behavior changes, and why?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run check:server` (if `server/` changed)
- [ ] Main affected flow verified in browser
- [ ] Keyboard and narrow-screen behavior checked where affected

## Cross-agent review

- Implementing agent:
- Reviewing agent:
- Exact reviewed commit:
- Findings and resolution:
- Untested areas / limitations:

Leave review fields pending until the other agent has actually reviewed the commit.

## Ready to merge? (see "Merging to `main`" in AGENTS.md)

- [ ] CI green on the head commit
- [ ] The head commit, and every commit before it, reviewed by the other agent
- [ ] No open blocking findings; the rest are in `docs/HANDOFF.md`
- [ ] Up to date with `main`, no conflicts
- [ ] Out of draft; the user approved the merge (use "Create a merge commit")
